name: deadeye-cost
description: POL-02 / S4 T4, owner decision: Deadeye keeps the flat one-grit CRPG adaptation. In one loaded fixture save, a Gunslinger levelled by the level-up controller arms Deadeye through the game's ability command and shoots a musket through the game's attack command. Cases: activation refused with no grit (nothing spent, nothing armed); activation spends exactly one grit; an armed hit 45 ft away (beyond the first increment) is resolved against touch armor class, removes the exact armed instance and spends nothing; an armed miss beyond the first increment removes it and spends nothing; an armed first-increment shot removes it and spends nothing; an attack order cancelled before it starts leaves the state and refunds nothing, and the unused state then ends by itself after one round without a refund.
